description: Record 1–500 x402 purchases as receipts. Costs USD 1 per wallet per calendar month over x402 (first upload of the month pays; the rest are free), from the wallet configured in X402RECEIPTS_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY (Base) or X402RECEIPTS_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY (Solana). Returns the settlement and the workspace the receipts were filed under.

payWith.description: Which configured wallet pays; default: the first configured

amountAtomic.description: Amount in the asset's smallest unit, e.g. 4000 = 0.004 USDC

asset.description: Asset address, e.g. USDC on Base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

delivered.description: Whether the purchase returned a successful response

id.description: Unique id for the receipt (uuid recommended)

network.description: CAIP-2 network the purchase was paid on, e.g. eip155:8453

requestHash.description: sha256 hex of method + url + body

sellerReceipt.description: The seller's signed x402 offer-receipt, if it issued one

name: x402receipts_record_receipts
title: x402receipts: record receipts
